documented_edge_interpretations: sigma == 0 -> z undefined -> session never eligible to trigger (the frozen quantity residual/sigma does not exist there; applied identically to all arms)

a trigger on the final session cannot fill (no t+1 session exists) and is dropped; a committed episode whose exit fill session does not exist inside the window is closed by a terminal FORCE_FLAT at the last session (bookkeeping truncation; the hold rule is never altered)

when an exit and a new entry land on the SAME fill session they merge into ONE canonical record with the final targets and NET ETF-leg turnover (identical to the single fill factory.value_book charges; different-symbol switch = both legs 1.0, same-symbol re-entry = 0.0)
notes: The scoring lane consumes build_arm_schedule / build_arm_schedule_from_features and factory.value_book unchanged; incremental mechanism alpha (risk-matched SPY via benchmarks.build_risk_matched_spy) is intentionally NOT built here - it is the scorer's path, and the freeze's constant-scale vol rule is recorded verbatim in the arm configs (target_daily_vol null, min_gross == max_gross) without inventing a numeric target vol.
